purpose: Matched gameplay composition variants using the hybrid concept as an edit target.

prompts.name: a-painted-2d-gameplay-v1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single landscape 16:9 game-screen concept.
Input image role: EDIT TARGET and exact composition / fox identity reference.
Preserve camera framing, objects, UI panel positions, text, gameplay state, exactly five dice in their five slots, their left-to-right top faces 2,2,2,5,5, the 24 bottom charm tiles in two rows of 12, fox pose resting cheek on paw with teacup, narrow fox muzzle and tall ears, green waistcoat, one large cream-tipped tail, rainy window left and lamp right. All other text must remain exactly as shown: THE LAST LANTERN, STAGE 2 / 25, HANDS 3, REROLLS 2, TARGET 225, FULL HOUSE, 36 x 6 = 216, REROLL SELECTED, PLAY HAND, CHARMS. No extra objects, no changed gameplay. Retain warm amber/rust/green and cool rain-blue palette. Change only the rendering art direction and the top-left label to "A / PAINTED 2D". Convert the ENTIRE scene, fox, dice, table and tokens into clearly flat, hand-illustrated 2D game art: confident ink silhouettes, deliberate flat color blocks, sparse drybrush texture, simplified bold shapes, just two or three cel-shaded tones, elegant storybook illustration. Render dice as hand-drawn sprite illustrations in their existing perspective, not 3D rendered dice. Make the room a stack of theatrical painted planes with no physically rendered materials, no ambient occlusion, no specular reflections, no realistic fur. Painted shadow shapes. The fox must feel drawn and expressive. The visual difference from the input must be immediately obvious: strongly graphic flat 2D illustration rather than a richly dimensional render. Maintain high quality readable UI, exact layout and same recognizable character. No collage, no new labels.

Preserve camera framing, objects, UI panel positions, text, gameplay state, exactly five dice in their five slots, their left-to-right top faces 2,2,2,5,5, the 24 bottom charm tiles in two rows of 12, fox pose resting cheek on paw with teacup, narrow fox muzzle and tall ears, green waistcoat, one large cream-tipped tail, rainy window left and lamp right.
